calls.parsed:
PARSE the provided edge list to construct the undirected graph G.
INITIALIZE an empty list to represent the current candidate path.
FOR each node in G DO
    SET the candidate path to start with the node.
    CALL BACKTRACK to extend the path.
ENDFOR

DEFINE BACKTRACK:
    IF the candidate path contains 12 nodes THEN
        STORE the candidate path as a Hamiltonian path candidate.
        RETURN success.
    ENDIF
    FOR each neighbor of the last node in the candidate path DO
        IF the neighbor is not already in the candidate path THEN
            APPEND the neighbor to the candidate path.
            CALL BACKTRACK recursively.
            IF a Hamiltonian path has been found THEN
                RETURN success.
            ENDIF
            REMOVE the neighbor from the candidate path.
        ENDIF
    ENDFOR
    RETURN failure.

IF a Hamiltonian path candidate was stored THEN
    VERIFY that the candidate includes all 12 nodes exactly once.
    VERIFY that each consecutive pair of nodes in the candidate corresponds to an edge in G.
    OUTPUT the verified Hamiltonian path.
ENDIF
IF no Hamiltonian path candidate was stored THEN
    OUTPUT that no Hamiltonian path exists.
ENDIF
